recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white family portrait framed within a thick, distressed black film-negative border, flanked by vertical white margins containing thin, spaced-out sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The central monochrome image is isolated by a heavy black frame against a clean white canvas.
Vertical text orientation mirrors the upright posture of the subjects.
The subjects' joyful expressions contrast with the stark, formal graphic framing.
coreInvariants: Distressed black film-strip border with visible sprocket hole artifacts
Vertical text alignment on both left and right outer margins
High-key white background within the photograph

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects (man, woman, child) are centrally clustered, filling approximately 70% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's large afro hairstyle acts as a dark visual weight at the top center of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical text on the right, moves to the central faces, and then to the vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space is maintained in the outer margins to emphasize the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white margins and background for high-key contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the film border and shadows in the portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red/pink used sparingly for the primary text on the right margin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black frame and white margins; low saturation overall.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical rotation of 90 degrees clockwise for all characters

composition.relationshipToImage: Separated by white space and black border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with color variation to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Film negative border with rough, organic edges
Thin vertical rule lines flanking the text

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric precision and clean lines typical of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a family with 1970s styling. Place this image inside a thick, distressed black film-negative frame with rough edges. Surround the entire frame with a wide white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the left and right white margins. Use extreme letter spacing. The right text should be muted red; the left text should be black.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Is the film border visibly distressed with organic edges?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the height of the image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red accent color
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the film border does not look like a simple rectangle.
Check that the text is perfectly centered within the white margins.
Verify that the red color is desaturated to match a vintage print look.
Confirm the subjects' clothing has visible texture despite the high contrast.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome portrait + Distressed film frame + Vertical geometric sans-serif + Wide white margins.
